tools.name: list_color_seasons
tools.description: List the 4 main seasons and 12 sub-seasons of seasonal colour analysis, with a link to each season's page and to a free test for finding your own season. Use when someone doesn't know their season or asks what the seasons are.

tools.name: browse_season
tools.description: A first look at in-stock clothes for one of the 4 main colour seasons (spring, summer, autumn, winter), with links to the shop. For a sub-season such as Soft Autumn, filters or search, use search_clothes.

tools.name: search_clothes
tools.description: Search in-stock clothes, shoes, accessories and makeup from many shops with every filter the website has: category, colour, shop, brand, size, material, occasion, style, price and sale. Use for any shopping request. Add a colour season (one of 12) only when the person knows theirs and wants clothes

tools.name: similar_but_cheaper
tools.description: Find pieces that look like a given product, in the same season and category, for less money. Pass a product id from search_clothes.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details for one product from search_clothes: price, sale price, colour, materials, sizes, which colour seasons it suits, a styling tip and the link to buy. Pass the product id.

tools.name: list_brands_and_shops
tools.description: List the brands and shops in the catalogue with the slug to pass to the brands or shops filter of search_clothes. Use when someone asks which brands or shops are available.

tools.name: second_hand_in_my_season
tools.description: Search second-hand listings in a colour season, with the same filters as search_clothes.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_clothes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search in-stock clothes, shoes, accessories and makeup for one of the 12 colour seasons with every filter the website has: category, colour, shop, brand, size, material, occasion, style, price and sale. Use for 'what should I wear', 'my colours', or any specific shopping request." → after: "Search in-stock clothes, shoes, accessories and makeup from many shops with every filter the website has: category, colour, shop, brand, size, material, occasion, style, price and sale. Use for any shopping request. Add a colour season (one of 12) only when the person knows theirs and wants clothes "

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
